verdict.rationale: Docs show a pre-run 'brief exchange' to set direction/topic (docs-10, docs-27, docs-32) and the ability to cancel a run in progress (docs-5), but there is no evidence of adjustable depth/effort/scope parameters or any mid-execution steering — once set, it 'works without further human input' (docs-1, docs-10). missing for 10: explicit controls for depth/effort/scope selection, ability to adjust or redirect the run while it executes (beyond outright cancellation), independent confirmation of steering capability.
